blocks.name: Full reconstruction
blocks.documentation:
Reconstruct full, phase-only or zero-phase magnitude components per color channel or in grayscale. Unsigned input maps to [0,1]; floating input retains its values. Output stays floating and signed unless explicit intensity normalization is chosen. Color output has three channels; original alpha remains on Source.

Selections zero input samples before the global transform. Native inverse scaling uses the padded transform length; the result is cropped back. Magnitude-only images use a new origin-based grid, while phase/full images retain source coordinates.

blocks.name: Original Fourier component fixtures — MIT
blocks.description: Original part illustration, color impulses, reference images, generator and projects under this repository's MIT license. The 16-bit bracket illustration shows component effects. Full reconstruction retains unit-range source samples; phase-only whitens reliable bins; magnitude-only uses a new zero-phase grid. Raw outputs are signed floating images. Preview contrast does not alter raw values; alpha remains on the original Source output. OpenCV DFT reference: https://docs.opencv.org/5.0/main_modules/core_array.html
